info.name: Love Story
info.plot: Jennifer e Oliver s'innamorano al college, e decidono di sposarsi anche se la famiglia di lui è contraria. Superano ogni difficoltà grazie al loro grande amore, ignorando che il destino è in agguato e minaccia il loro futuro insieme.

translations.overview: Harvard Law student Oliver Barrett IV and music student Jennifer Cavilleri share a chemistry they cannot deny - and a love they cannot ignore. Despite their opposite backgrounds, the young couple put their hearts on the line for each other. When they marry, Oliver's wealthy father threatens to disown him. Jenny tries to reconcile the Barrett men, but to no avail.
translations.tagline: Love means never having to say you’re sorry.
